sources.title: YOLO-Fusion and Internet of Things: Advancing object detection in smart ...
sources.snippet: The paper introduces YOLO-Fusion, a deep learning model for smart transportation that enhances object detection by fusing infrared and visible-light images. Using modules like FusionAttention, Dynamic Fusion, and FD Loss, YOLO-Fusion excels in feature representation and detection accuracy, particularly on DroneVehicle and FLIR datasets.
